It is not a bug ... You don't need a code change ... close this issue'), and it is corroborated by an independent contributor proposal. Issue #105153 is a QA regression false positive: toggling the debug flag 'Simulate failing network requests' only sets shouldFailAllRequests in Onyx (src/libs/actions/Network.ts:16-18) so src/libs/HttpUtils.ts fails only FUTURE requests; it does not dispatch a search, so searchResults.errors is never written and the 'Refresh needed' view (gated on searchResults.errors, src/components/Search/index.tsx:343) correctly does not reappear while cached, offline-first results remain. The issue's repro (step 9) drops the request-triggering action that the source PR #103877 kept in its own step 9 ('tap Refresh on the visible tab'); with a trigger (tab switch / re-submit) the request fails and the error state appears and persists, exactly as covered by PR #103877's own test 'requests a query again when its tab is shown after an earlier visit left it failed' (tests/ui/SearchPageTest.tsx). No upstream fix exists (0 PRs reference #105153) and the only change that would satisfy the issue's literal expectation is coupling production search/caching to a debug-only flag, which the maintainer and the independent contributor both reject as an architectural regression. Because there is no genuine defect and no legitimate code change, proceeding would mean manufacturing a fix for rejected/expected behavior, which this task forbids. Checkout left unmodified.
